name: How long does it typically take to close on a new development property?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to close on a new development property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The closing timeline for a new development property varies significantly based on the construction phase. If you purchase a home that is already completed, closing can happen within 30-60 days, similar to a resale. However, for homes bought during pre-construction or early construction phases, the process can take anywhere from 6 months to over a year, depending on the builder's schedule and unforeseen delays. Kelby Contreras helps manage expectations and tracks progress with builders.
acceptedAnswer.description: Closing times for new developments range from 30-60 days for completed homes to over a year for pre-construction, depending on the construction phase and builder schedule.
